clips.title: The story
paras: Along Westfall's coast, Captain Sanders' last directions point out to sea. A note in an old jug sends scavengers west toward his buried treasure.

Captain Sanders left his final directions in an old whiskey jug on the Westfall coast. The pirate had scattered cryptic notes along the shoreline, and this one completes the trail. From the jug, the directions lead due west into the ocean. Follow them through the surf to a lonely offshore rock, where his ironbound sea chest lies.
